source.quote_free_summary: WSDC Jack and Jill preliminaries use the WSDC-approved Callback system: Yes 10, Alternates 4.5/4.3/4.2, No 0, at most three Alternate levels, outcome is the sum, and the Chief Judge's unique raw scores break a tie only after the original calculation.

format: WSDC Jack and Jill preliminary callbacks
requirement: Not built and not claimed. The Studio callback tally (yes-only, by entry) is DanceFlow policy and is not WSDC callback scoring. A future WSDC profile would need alternates, No values, per-role panels and the Chief Judge raw-score tie-break, verified separately.
enforcement_point: None. OD-01 (PR 832) blocks approval and publication of Studio-scored results for a declared WSDC event.
interpretation_notes: The callback system is defined by the pinned text; gaps (unmarked judges, direction of the raw-score tie-break, missing Chief Judge score, rounding, the missing 'Appendix') are listed in docs/competition/governance/scoring-sources/OD-24-scoring-source-candidates.md section 4. Algorithm correctness, rule compliance and WSDC approval are separate (see OD24-WSDC-0002).
decision_refs: OD-24 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A; retrospective audit PR #795)
